source_tables.description: Service indicator data. PeopleSoft's term for holds/restrictions. Links person to service indicator with start/end dates.
Service indicator definition. Type, description, which services it impacts.
Service indicator result. Maps indicators to specific impacts (registration, transcript, etc.).

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from institution_id + EMPLID + SRVC_IND_CD + START_DT

Map PS service indicator types to HELIX hold types. PS distinguishes positive ('H'=honors) from negative ('N'=holds). Filter to negative indicators only for HELIX Hold. Map by SRVC_IND_CD to helix/hold-type.
If END_DT is null or > today → 'active'. If END_DT <= today → 'released'. PeopleSoft auto-expires by END_DT.
Combine indicator description with specific reason text.
Cast to ISO 8601. Future dates = auto-expiration.
Direct map. Department that placed the indicator.
Map PS service indicator results to HELIX prevents array: 'ENRL'→'registration', 'TRAN'→'transcript_release', 'GRAD'→'graduation'. One row per impact.
